design_notes: Gate order per DES-AFC-P2-POLICY: matched types intersect enabled types, then game-day periods, quiet hours (UTC minutes, wrap-aware, start inclusive / end exclusive), close-game once-per-game suppression, per-game alert_min_gap on release times, spoiler delay sets emittedAt = eventTime + spoilerDelay.

Red zone: fieldPosition < 20 and possession equals a matched starter's team (20 excluded). Player score: scoringPlay and a matched starter athlete_id in playerIds. Close game: period >= 4 and margin <= 8.
Commentary templates name no player or team and insert only score, margin, field position, period and 20, so no on-field or will-score claim is possible; Off attaches None.
